name: @hydra/dsh-fleet-extras
description: Prototype: the V3 hcom borrow (issue #26, orchestration-v3 §4 P3.3) — workspace watch + subscribe + 30 s collision detection. Agents register watch intent over explicit paths; a polling scanner (zero deps, scan() driven) detects workspace changes (fleet/workspace-change); two DIFFERENT actors writing the SAME file within the collision window (default 30 s) fire fleet/collision with the actors, the file, and the window — the shared-worktree protection pattern. Every event publishes with originKind 'extras' (self-trigger guard), signed via fleet-agent when available. Registers ctx.fleetExtras + the extras_watch / extras_subscribe / extras_collisions tools. Issue #26.
